title: tx_queue/main.c: Buffer size mismatch causes potential over-read
description:
Line 100-101: Test declares uint8_t data[10] but passes TX_QUEUE_MAX_PACKET_SIZE + 1 as the length parameter to tx_queue_push(). This misrepresents the actual buffer size. If the implementation reads any data before validating the length parameter, this is undefined behavior. ASAN may flag this as a buffer over-read. Fix: declare the buffer as uint8_t data[TX_QUEUE_MAX_PACKET_SIZE + 1] to match the claimed length.
